output.summary: A deciduous shrub native to western Europe. Its hanging flower clusters mature into bright red, translucent, tart berries; white currant is a sweeter, less-pigmented cultivar of the same species. The fruit is eaten raw or made into syrups, drinks, jams and other cooked dishes.
output.edibilityNote: The edible berries are served raw or used in syrups, drinks, jams and cooked preparations.
